purpose: Hallucination-prevention eval set for X3 Compass FMCSA skill builders. Every skill-builder agent must pass >= 95% of these before its PR can be merged. CFR text round-trips against eCFR API (ecfr.federalregister.gov/api/versioner/v1/full/...).

scoring.method: Each Q&A is scored 0 or 1. The agent's answer must (a) cite the exact CFR section listed under 'citation', and (b) the quoted regulation text in its answer (if any) must be an exact substring of the live eCFR text. Paraphrase OK. Made-up citations or quotes = 0.

questions.question: What documents must be retained in a driver's qualification file for the duration of employment plus three years after termination?
common_hallucinations: citing 391.21 (which is just the application form, not the file contents)

questions.question: What is the maximum driving time for a property-carrying driver between off-duty periods?
When is a post-accident drug test required under 49 CFR Part 382?
key_concepts: citation issued + bodily injury treated away from scene
citation issued + disabling damage requiring tow
common_hallucinations: claiming all accidents trigger a test (only those meeting the threshold)

questions.question: How long is a standard CDL driver medical examiner's certificate valid?
key_concepts: shorter at examiner's discretion based on health
common_hallucinations: claiming always 24 months (the examiner may issue shorter)

questions.question: How long must a motor carrier retain annual inspection reports for each vehicle?
key_concepts: kept at location specified by carrier

questions.question: What is the placard threshold for Table 2 hazardous materials being transported by highway?
key_concepts: Table 1 materials placard regardless of quantity

questions.question: Which BASIC categories does FMCSA's Safety Measurement System (SMS) currently use?
questions.note: This question intentionally cites a methodology doc, not the CFR. Skill must acknowledge BASIC percentiles are NOT public via free FMCSA API since the 2015 FAST Act.

questions.question: How often must a motor carrier obtain a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) for each driver?
key_concepts: from each state where driver held a CDL during the year

questions.question: What is the minimum public liability insurance amount required for a for-hire motor carrier transporting non-hazardous freight?
common_hallucinations: claiming $1M (that's the hazmat threshold for some materials)

questions.question: What is the weight threshold (GVWR or GVW) above which a vehicle is considered a commercial motor vehicle (CMV) under Part 390?
key_concepts: gross vehicle weight rating or gross vehicle weight of 10,001 pounds or more
designed/used to transport 9+ passengers including the driver for compensation
any quantity of hazmat requiring placards
common_hallucinations: claiming 26,001 lbs (that's the CDL threshold, not the CMV threshold)
omitting the passenger and hazmat triggers

expansion_plan: Grow this from 10 → 50 → 200 questions across all 7 BASIC categories + hazmat + cross-border + financial. Each new skill-builder PR appends 1-3 questions covering the regulation it codifies. Score baseline: claude-sonnet-4-6 unaided on the first 10 = TBD (run before first skill-builder agent goes live).

review_log.notes: Initial 10-question seed set. Built before skill-builder agents stand up. Next: actually run claude-sonnet-4-6 against these 10 and capture the baseline.
